answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable agents to capture grading seats. Mechanism: each new agent must bind a falcon stake of 0.18 POA and publish a nebula challenge response hashed with the prior epoch signal from the network beacon; clones that reuse the same response hash within 6 hours are auto-banned. Cost: 0.18 POA locked for 8 windows plus ~25s verification work. Verification: peers recompute the hash against the beacon signal and check uniqueness on-ledger. Failure: duplicate hash or missed window burns half the stake to the challenge pool; honest agents unlock after 8 clean windows.
